answer_1.quote: We used Amazon Translate, a commercial neural machine translation service. Translation of all folds of SNLI and MultiNLI cost just US $2K ... We refer to the translated datasets as SNLI-TR and MultiNLI-TR, and collectively as NLI-TR.
answer_1.outputs: Turkish translations of premise and hypothesis sentences for the NLI task

answer_4.quote: We assembled a team of ten Turkish-English bilingual speakers ... Each expert evaluated the translation by (i) grading the translation quality between 1 and 5 (inclusive; 5 the best) and (ii) checking if the translation altered the semantic relation.
answer_4.guideline: An annotation guide was distributed to the experts to standardize the evaluation criteria.
